selections.label: NAP
selections.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Novice Stakes
selections.reference_type: Timeform published bookmaker price; illustrative, not Betfair Exchange
selections.rationale: Second in both starts this season; most recently beaten just 3/4 length in 10-runner Southwell novice over 6f on 26 Oct; return to 7f likely helpful based on prior 7f form and the unsuitable 6f drop. Relevant proven recent AW form in a novice contest.
selections.main_risks: Unraced El Ra'ady from William Haggas could be better than maiden class, and Nip About is a course-and-distance runner-up; Big Money has not yet won and drawing gate 8 introduces uncertainty.

selections.label: Shadow
selections.race: All-Weather Championship Is Back EBF Novice Stakes (Div I)
selections.reference_type: Timeform published bookmaker price; illustrative, not Betfair Exchange
selections.rationale: On debut finished second of 12, beaten only half a length over 6f at Newcastle on 2 October despite racing traffic/slow break; extra furlong may suit. Proven on this Tapeta track and jockey Hollie Doyle rides.
selections.main_risks: Only one run; stepping up a furlong is inference, not demonstrated ability; Idealise and Tabkir pose realistic dangers and juvenile improvement is uncertain.

why_no_third: Other reviewed later races had less independently compelling documented form support relative to opposition; the experiment allows fewer than three. Do not force a third or later backfill.
